for_C_validator.rule: READY is accepted ONLY when every evidence field below is present with the required value. No optional/missing/unknown/probe:false object may imply a pass. Reject and re-run the doctor otherwise.

invocation.cache: CLI --cache <path> writes bounded atomic evidence (tmp+rename, 4KB cap); home server reads ME_DOCTOR_CACHE or <HOME_DB-dir>/doctor-cache.json. Installers: HOME_DB=$ME_DATA_DIR/home.sqlite, ME_DOCTOR_CACHE=$ME_DATA_DIR/doctor-cache.json. TTL 300s, stale/oversize/pin-mismatch => setup-needed, never configured.
invocation.cwd_contract: cwd-independent: the vendor lock resolves from the installed module root (import.meta.url), never process.cwd(). The installer may invoke from a setup/data dir (e.g. /opt/me/infra/src/cli.mjs). C tests must invoke from an arbitrary cwd.
invocation.env_files: ME_UPSTREAM_ENV_FILE (operator 0600 env; sourced by installer + compose). Model selection lives in BOT_PROVIDER/BOT_MODEL + provider keys + OPENAI_BASE_URL there — the same file the harness container and tenant model.yaml read. No second HOME_MODEL_* default for FULL.
invocation.live_tracker: In-home singleflight refresh loop (interval 120s, 30s probe deadline) maintains in-memory evidence; phone capability reads never await the network; config loss/source failure/TTL expiry => not-live immediately; cache file is restart seed + C diagnostic only.
invocation.module: src/upstream-doctor.mjs checkUpstreamPlatform({env, fetchImpl, repoRoot?, probe, sdkClient?, deployedVerifier?}); src/upstream-live.mjs createLiveTracker({env, fetchImpl, intervalMs, ttlMs, now, cachePath}); sdkClient/deployedVerifier are TEST-ONLY seams, production always verifies for real
invocation.sdk_host_recipe: mkdir -p $HOME/me-intel-sdk && cd $HOME/me-intel-sdk && npm init -y && npm i --no-save @copilotkit/runtime@1.83.0; INTELLIGENCE_SDK_ROOT=$HOME/me-intel-sdk doctor ... (B's Python harness image does not supply it)

note: Independence: the doctor is trusted release code; the installer/cache paths are operator-owned (0600/0700). Live evidence cache: data-dir doctor-cache.json {protocol, state, mode, pin, at, ttlMs:300000}; the home server trusts it only when fresh + READY + pin-matched (fullConfigured = configValid && live).

checks_datastore.permissions: no world-writable storage dir (home-data, OPENBOT_CHECKOUT); otherwise FAILED

checks_model.provider: openai|anthropic|google from BOT_PROVIDER (prefix in BOT_MODEL wins); single source with harness container + tenant model.yaml

fleet.computers: array with per-person/per-bot computer keys ({computer: 'person:<id>'|'bot:<id>', kind})

checks_nativeAuth.roleGate: user-denied (admin fleet to user assertion => FAILED shared provider)

checks_postgres.live: TCP answers + native agents read proves SQL/migrations

deployed.approvedFootprintOnly: tracked modifications ⊆ {server/src/index.ts, server/src/config.ts} (index.ts mandatory); untracked ⊆ {home-bridge.ts, node_modules/, .openbot/, egress.env, .langchain/}; anything else => drift FAILED
deployed.head: == lock revision == pin (git rev-parse)
deployed.manifestOk: exact post-hashes from vendor/openbot/patches/manifest.json (F-owned, REQUIRED — a missing/unreadable/tampered manifest fails closed; post-hash verification is never optional)

checks_supervisor.docker: must be true (false => FAILED, computers cannot run)

checks_telemetry.enforced: OPENBOT_PRODUCT_TELEMETRY on / kill-switches off / DO_NOT_TRACK off => FAILED

states.FAILED: misconfig, drift, bad/rejected credentials, expired/misconfigured licence, unsafe SINGLE_USER, managed default without opt-in, privacy/storage violations, unpatched upstream, docker:false. Blocks install/READY. Shared fleet provider answering an admin route to a user assertion fails explicitly.
states.NEEDS_INPUT: missing operator input (tokens, OAuth, key/license/model, OPENBOT_CHECKOUT, SDK package, unreachable services) or probe:false. Honest operator gate; completable (Anthropic included via read-only /v1/models).
states.READY: ALL required evidence above verified together. probe:false can never yield READY.

candidate_source_ci.flow: upstream-openbot.yml: candidate job (read-only, contents:read, no secrets) fetches the candidate bundle + re-verifies digests + checks the home patch still applies to the candidate seam (index.ts + config.ts); candidate-source-test job re-verifies the uploaded artifact (digest recompute + schema) in isolation; propose job (writer creds) only opens a review PR, never executes candidate code. No automerge, no deploy.
candidate_source_ci.trusted_vs_executed: The revision.json artifact is trusted metadata (written by the read-only candidate job); the candidate sources themselves never run in CI.
